Project Overview
A multi-section marketing/landing page website being built and refined, with a focus on mobile responsiveness. Files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`.

## Completed Work
1. Fixed navbar mobile layout (hamburger + logo centering)
2. Fixed hero section mobile layout (text, image, padding)
3. Fixed stats strip mobile (2-col grid, spacing)
4. Fixed about section mobile (single column, badge positioning)
5. Fixed products grid mobile (2-col → 1-col on small screens)
6. Fixed why-us grid mobile (2-col → 1-col)
7. Fixed gallery grid mobile (2-col, proper sizing)
8. Fixed testimonials mobile (single column)
9. Reverted `script.js` from left-drawer pattern to simple dropdown toggle (no overlay, no body scroll lock)
10. Applied `style.css` modifications (mobile responsive fixes across all sections)
11. Fixed logo appearing between nav menu items on mobile: initially used `visibility: hidden`, then updated to `display: none` so logo takes no layout space when menu is open (fixes gap between Products and Why Us nav items)

## Key Technical Decisions
- Navbar uses dropdown toggle style (not a side drawer): hamburger on right, logo centered at top, tapping hamburger drops menu inline
- No overlay element, no `body overflow: hidden` on mobile menu open
- Hamburger uses span transforms for X animation when open
- Nav links use `getElementById` (`navLinksLeft`, `navLinksRight`) and `classList.toggle`
- Mobile breakpoints handled in `style.css` with media queries
- Logo visibility toggled via JS using `display: none` (not `visibility: hidden`) when menu is open, so it takes no layout space and doesn't create a gap between nav items; restored with `display: ''` on close

## Relevant Files & Code
- `index.html` — Main HTML structure (open tab)
- `style.css` — All styles including mobile responsive rules
- `script.js` — Hamburger toggle logic (most recently modified); current version:
  - Uses `getElementById` for `hamburger`, `navLinksLeft`, `navLinksRight`
  - Uses `document.querySelector('.logo-link')` for logo reference
  - `classList.toggle('open')` on hamburger click
  - Span transforms for X animation
  - Hides logo (`display: none`) when menu opens so no gap appears between nav items
  - Restores logo (`display: ''`) on close via `resetHamburger()`
  - Closes menu and restores logo on nav link click via `resetHamburger()`

## Current Status
All 8 mobile layout tasks are completed. `script.js` is on the simple dropdown toggle pattern (no drawer, no overlay). Logo gap bug between Products and Why Us nav items has been fixed by switching from `visibility: hidden` to `display: none`. All requested work is complete.

## Pending Tasks
None explicitly requested.
